summary: SOL ~$107 (+2.3% 24h). Alpenglow consensus upgrade activated on mainnet-beta (finality ~150ms, confirmed by Anza), and R3 is bringing its Corda platform to Solana; Solana's monthly active users hit a one-year high of 53.6M. Solana ETFs saw a small -$2.65M outflow on 20 Oct. Alpenglow was partly priced in from this morning's score, so held at 0.22.
catalyst_note: Alpenglow activated on Solana mainnet-beta; R3 Corda integration on Solana
